pages.title: Machine Knitting/Edges
pages.extract:
= Edges =

This is a short stand-in page written for the BuildBot tests. It covers edges in machine knitting in a few plain lines.


== Starting edges ==
A starting edge holds the first row of loops so the work does not run back. Keep the first row loose and knit a few rows before letting go of the yarn end.
A folded hem makes a neat starting edge: knit twice the hem height, then hang the first loops back on the needles.


== Side edges ==
Side edges, or selvedges, look tidier when the end stitch is slipped or knitted the same way on every row.


== Finishing edges ==
Neckbands, armholes and collars are finished edges. Pick up the loops evenly and knit the band a little tighter than the body so it lies flat.
